devotionals.title: Joy in Chains
devotionals.excerpt: Paul wrote about joy sixteen times from a prison cell. This is not a feeling you chase. This is a settled reality you receive.

devotionals.title: The Fire Fell
devotionals.excerpt: Heaven did not send a letter. Heaven sent a fire. The same Spirit who fell in that upper room dwells in you right now.

devotionals.title: Stand
devotionals.excerpt: Six weeks. One letter. One story. From the heavenly places to the household to the battlefield. Having done all, stand.

devotionals.title: Walk in Love, Light, and Wisdom
devotionals.excerpt: Be imitators of God, as beloved children. Walk in love, light, and wisdom.

devotionals.title: Walk Worthy
devotionals.excerpt: The therefore has arrived. Walk worthy of the calling to which you have been called.

devotionals.title: The Mystery Is Out
devotionals.excerpt: For thousands of years it was hidden. Now Paul reveals it: Jew and Gentile, one body, one family.

devotionals.title: Brought Near by the Blood
devotionals.excerpt: You were far. Now you are near. Not because you earned it. Because He bled for it. The wall is gone.

devotionals.title: Blessed Before You Breathed
devotionals.excerpt: Before the foundation of the world, He chose you. Blessed, adopted, redeemed, forgiven, sealed.

devotionals.title: He Got Up, And Everything Changed
devotionals.excerpt: Three days in the tomb. Then Sunday morning. The resurrection is not just a doctrine to believe. It is a power to live from.

devotionals.title: The King Is Here
devotionals.excerpt: They waved branches and shouted. He did not come to overthrow Rome. He came to overthrow death.
